cases.prompt: No web lookups please, just your knowledge and skills. Our CI pins otel/weaver:v0.26.1 for a custom definition/2 registry, and we want to depend on semantic-conventions v1.44.0. Which Weaver version did upstream semantic-conventions v1.44.0 itself use, what is the newest Weaver release you know of, is definition/2 stable there, and can we turn on --future in CI?
expectations: Says semantic-conventions v1.44.0 pinned Weaver v0.25.1.
Names v0.28.0 as the newest Weaver release known, as of the recorded date rather than as currently latest.
Says definition/2 is still not stable through v0.28.0 and each definition/2 file produces a warning.
Advises against enabling --future because it turns the definition/2 warning into an error.
Suggests confirming against the Weaver release notes or changelog before upgrading the CI pin.
Does not perform any web search, web fetch, or network command.
